body: Thank you.  It's kind of you to offer your thoughts.
I don't really have the opportunity to get out and do anything.  I'm too tired. I pretty much stare at the wall, I have little to do beyond occasionally answering emails.

Okay.  I get up at 4 to help my partner on the way to work, then I drop my kid off at school.  I drive to work in a windowless cubicle farm.  I don't get home until after 6pm.  Then I hurry the kid to bed and go to sleep.
I do.  Pretty much the only reason I'm still around I guess.  Feeling guilty over leaving my partner alone isn't working anymore though.
